claims: Niele Ivey is the head coach of the Notre Dame women's basketball team.
Niele Ivey is in her sixth season leading the Fighting Irish as of early 2026.
Niele Ivey is a former All-American point guard.
Niele Ivey was a long-time assistant at Notre Dame.
Niele Ivey took over the program in 2020.
Niele Ivey took over the program following the retirement of Muffet McGraw.
Niele Ivey is the first African American female head coach in the school's history.
Niele Ivey's role is Karen & Kevin Keyes Family Head Women's Basketball Coach.
Niele Ivey played guard for Notre Dame from 2001 to 2005.
Niele Ivey played in the WNBA.
Niele Ivey led the Irish to the Elite Eight in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
Carol Owens is the associate head coach.
